mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHAT_POST ( user_idx, title, created_at ) VALUES ( #{user_idx}, #{title}, NOW() )
INSERT INTO CHAT_COMMENT ( chat_post_idx, user_idx, comment_role, content, comment_order, created_at ) VALUES ( #{chat_post_idx}, #{user_idx}, #{comment_role}, #{content}, #{comment_order}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT chat_post_idx, user_idx, title, created_at FROM CHAT_POST WHERE user_idx = #{userIdx} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT c.chat_comment_idx, c.chat_post_idx, c.user_idx, c.comment_role, c.content, c.comment_order, c.created_at FROM CHAT_COMMENT c INNER JOIN CHAT_POST p ON c.chat_post_idx = p.chat_post_idx WHERE c.chat_post_idx = #{chatPostIdx} AND p.user_idx = #{userIdx} ORDER BY c.comment_order ASC
